camel_example: aliyun ddoscoo DescribeDestinationPortEvent --region cn-hangzhou --EventType defense --Ip '203.107.XX.XX' --StartTime 1720059000 --Region cn --Range 2
description_en: Queries the number of request packets received by the destination ports of the attacked IP address that is protected by Anti-DDoS Proxy
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防被攻击IP的目的端口包数量信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-destination-port-event --biz-region cn --event-type defense --start-time 1720059000 --ip 203.107.XX.XX --range 2 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDestinationPortEvent

parameters.help_en:
The region in which your service is deployed. Valid values:

cn: a region in the Chinese mainland.

cn-hongkong: a region outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
服务地域。取值：
cn：中国内地。
cn-hongkong：非中国内地
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The type of the attack event that you want to query. Valid values:

defense: attack events that trigger traffic scrubbing.

blackhole: attack events that trigger blackhole filtering
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的攻击事件类型。取值：

defense：流量型攻击清洗事件。
blackhole：流量型攻击黑洞事件
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。

必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the attacker
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The number of destination ports to return. The ports are sorted in descending order of the number of received request packets. By default, the first 10 ports are returned
parameters.help_zh: 要返回的目的端口数量。按照请求包数量由大到小排序，默认返回前10个IP
parameters.name: range

InPkts.description_en: The number of request packets received by the destination port
InPkts.description_zh: 目的端口的请求包数量

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的 ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
